notes.title: Elf Breeding Farm now on Mac
notes.content:
[b]Thanks everyone for supporting the launch of Elf Breeding Farm! [/b]

We're excited to announce that we've got a MacOS version of the game live on Steam now so even more of you can enjoy living that 'slow life' on the farm with elves as far as the eye can see.

We have also been reading the Steam reviews (thanks for leaving us feedback) and decided to add some additional features, such as:
[list]
[*] When you input a blank player name it should return to the default name.
[*] You can mute the "peeing inside the elves" sound in the options menu.
[/list]

Thanks again for all your support and look forward to the announcement of our NEXT game [i]soon[/i]~
